categories.main_business_segments: Guangdong Suqun New Material Co., Ltd. primarily operates as a diversified functional materials provider focusing on thermal management materials. Its main product lines include graphite heat dissipation films, graphite heat sinks, thermal interface materials such as thermal pads and gels, heat pipes, heat spreaders, cooling modules, and liquid cooling plates. The company also produces magnetic materials and nano-protection materials, serving industries like consumer electronics, automotive electronics, photovoltaic energy storage, smart home, servers, communications, medical devices, and drones.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies including high-temperature sintering, directional forming, surface modification, nano synthesis, precision coating, and vacuum coating. It emphasizes proprietary processes for producing synthetic graphite materials and thermal management solutions. Production follows a make-to-order and lean manufacturing model with standardized management systems, while R&D focuses on developing high-performance thermal interface materials, organic silicon encapsulants, and coating technologies to enhance product quality and efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading global and domestic technology and consumer electronics companies such as Xiaomi, Vivo, Samsung, Google, ABB, Flex, BYD, Foxconn, TCL Huaxing Optoelectronics, Tianma Microelectronics, Wingtech Communications, and Longcheer Electronics. The company serves major markets in consumer electronics (smartphones, tablets, laptops, wearables), automotive electronics (new energy vehicles, power batteries), energy storage, servers, smart home, communications, and medical equipment sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters and manufacturing facilities in Dongguan, Guangdong Province. It has expanded internationally with wholly-owned subsidiaries and joint ventures in Hong Kong and Vietnam. Its sales are predominantly domestic (over 93% of revenue), with a smaller portion exported overseas, including significant business with North American customers.
categories.supply_chain_position: Guangdong Suqun New Material Co., Ltd. operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain as a manufacturer and supplier of functional thermal management materials and components. It procures raw materials such as PI films and adhesives upstream and supplies finished thermal solutions downstream to OEMs and brand owners in electronics and automotive industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes becoming a global leader in high-reliability electronic system protection and thermal control technologies. R&D efforts focus on enhancing thermal management materials, integrating waterproof sealing designs, and developing solutions spanning chip-level to device-level applications. Key R&D projects include high-performance graphite films, liquid cooling products, high-adhesion coatings, and advanced encapsulants. The company also invests in digital transformation and precision manufacturing to improve production efficiency and product quality.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of thermal management materials and related functional products to major customers. The company follows a direct sales model with customized product development and system solutions. Revenue recognition occurs at the point of product delivery and customer acceptance, with contracts typically involving product sales rather than services or licensing.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading provider of thermal management solutions in the electronic components manufacturing industry, recognized for its comprehensive product portfolio and strong technical capabilities. It competes with other specialized thermal materials manufacturers serving consumer electronics and automotive sectors. Its competitive advantages include advanced proprietary technologies, cost control, and established relationships with top-tier global and domestic customers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 656 million, representing a 51.1% year-over-year increase. Net profit attributable to shareholders was about RMB 52.5 million, slightly declining by 3.88%. Total assets grew by 26.9% to RMB 1.52 billion, and net assets increased by 3.7% to RMB 1.03 billion. The company has shown rapid growth driven by expanding market demand, capacity ramp-up, and increased R&D investment.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Guangdong Suqun New Material Co., Ltd. differentiates itself by offering a broad and integrated range of thermal management and multifunctional materials with advanced proprietary technologies. It provides one-stop solutions addressing diverse thermal and protective needs of electronic and electrical products. The company emphasizes high product quality, cost efficiency, and strong customer collaboration to maintain leadership in key markets such as consumer electronics and new energy vehicles.
